## Do not disclose vulnerability details here

For security vulnerabilities, close this issue without adding technical details and submit a private report through:

https://github.com/Stellar-MarkeyPay/Stellar-MarketPay/security/advisories/new

## Safe public context

If this is a general security hardening suggestion with no exploitable details, describe the non-sensitive improvement here.

## Affected area

- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend or API
- [ ] Soroban contract
- [ ] Deployment or infrastructure
